entities.name: Strefan Maurer
entities.description: A vampire lord who has outrun death, hunted for decades by Brandt, and is trapped in a haunted ruin that is his family's manor.

entities.name: Brandt
entities.description: An aged vampire hunter missing part of an ear who has pursued Strefan for decades and lures him to a ruin before cutting his own throat.

entities.name: The Hladvora
entities.description: A shapeshifting creature that lives in the ruined manor, lures prey, takes over bodies and feeds on fear and blood.

entities.name: Strefan's mother
entities.description: Strefan's long-dead mother, whose likeness the Hladvora imitates.

entities.name: Strefan's father
entities.description: Strefan's father, whose death led Strefan to choose never to die and whose likeness the Hladvora wears.

entities.name: The twins
entities.description: Guards Strefan once placed at his family manor.

entities.name: Strefan's family manor
entities.description: A ruin on a snowy steppe that rises as a vibrant mansion when Brandt's blood is spilled and traps Strefan; it was his family's home.

entities.name: Shadowgrange
entities.description: The village where Strefan sees Brandt ride past after years.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane from which the angel is absent.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The absent angel whose blessed symbols still frighten Strefan a little.

events.summary: Strefan survives falling into Brandt's stake pit, fends off a thrown vial of blessed water and escapes.
events.quote: He screamed as he felt his exposed skin burn.

events.summary: Strefan hurls a stake and wounds Brandt, then chases him as he flees on horseback.
events.quote: Bloodlust rising, he rose into the air and rushed in pursuit.

events.summary: Brandt's horse falls at a ruin, and Brandt slashes Strefan with a hidden blade before cutting his own throat.
events.quote: slit his own throat from ear to ear

events.summary: Brandt's blood vanishes into the stones and a vibrant mansion rises around Strefan, who finds he cannot leave through the door.
events.quote: now walls had sprung up around him.

events.summary: In a flashback Strefan recalls his first encounter with Brandt decades earlier, when Brandt tore his glamer by shouting that a vampire was in the village.
events.quote: the young man began hollering that there was a vampire in their midst

events.summary: Brandt's drained body rises and moves toward Strefan, now inhabited by something else.
events.quote: the body lurched to its feet

events.summary: The creature writes its name Hladvora in blood and attacks, and Strefan strangles the body.
Strefan moves through the house and is terrified by a wallpaper face mimicking his dead mother.
Strefan realizes the Hladvora is feeding on his fear and that the house is his family's ruined manor.
events.quote: The Hladvora had been feeding on him, drawing on his fear.

events.summary: Strefan falls through a floor into his father's deathbed room and sees his father's corpse stir.
events.quote: Beneath his gaze, his father stirred and began to open his eyes.

events.summary: Strefan notices the wrong eyes and loose skin and tears the false father open to reveal a half-formed, many-toothed creature.
events.quote: Weeping, with all his strength, he tore his father open.

events.summary: Strefan strangles the creature until it bursts into blood that vanishes into the floor, and the house disappears.
events.quote: And then suddenly it burst into a torrent of blood within his hands.

events.summary: Strefan staggers out of the ruin, weak and starving, and fears he might die after all.

relations.quote: He'd been pursued by Brandt in the years that had followed

relations.note: He wants to kill the vampire hunter.
relations.quote: This would be his best opportunity in years to do away with Brandt once and for all.

relations.note: It feeds on him and attacks him.
relations.quote: He was the provender this time, the cattle.

relations.note: His father's death led him to choose never to die.
relations.quote: this death, the pain of it, was what had caused him to make the decision never to die

relations.note: The creature imitates his mother's voice.
relations.quote: he could still recognize his mother's cadences

relations.note: Strefan placed them as guards at his family manor.
relations.quote: He had placed them here as guards to prevent just this.
